description: Land Acquisition - Thalagoda, Naula D/S Division, Matale District	 and Rambukoluwa, Laggala-Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition declarations under the Land Acquisition Act. It describes specific parcels of land being acquired for public purposes, including detailed descriptions of locations, boundaries, extents, and survey information. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized categories. The presence of the Minister's name is incidental to the land acquisition process rather than being the primary focus of the gazette.
